name: Subconscious
vision_statement: A request recalls the part of the person's own knowledge its goal needs, from cards that are current with their sources, found by meaning and proportionate in size, and never from anyone else's.
opportunities: The cards a person's work leaves behind are copies of what lives elsewhere, so the store itself raises questions the parent solution does not ask: when a card has drifted from its source file, how an assistant keeps serving the last known listing while a backend is down and replays the writes that failed, how a store is kept proportionate to its sources instead of inflating with copies from a backups folder, which folders a corpus may index at all, and how a card is found by meaning when the person asks in other words. Each has alternatives that can be measured against each other.
solution_coherence: Subconscious recalls the cards that match a request through Hub card store. Hub card store keeps the cards through Context card persistence backend, and Context card persistence backend serves the last known listing while a backend is down with Offline card cache and write outbox. Card store repair decides which sources deserve a card by asking Index scope decision before it rewrites anything. The remaining parts of the area do not use one another in code, so they are grouped here by purpose, the care of a card store that stays current, proportionate and findable. Source-change staleness detector reports the cards that have drifted from their source file. Card store growth prevention keeps a store proportionate to its sources. Card categories and metadata gives each card its labels. QAR topic cards for a folder proposes the topic cards a lane indexes.
